meta.description: Active and recent alerts across the demo estate
meta.disclaimer: SIMULATED TELEMETRY — demonstration dataset. Not actual customer data.

alerts.title: Peak demand excursion probability 94%
alerts.detail: Maximum demand is tracking to exceed the contracted 10.2 MVA ceiling within 40 minutes.
alerts.recommendation: Discharge BESS at 1.8 MW and shed non-critical HVAC for 35 minutes.

alerts.title: BESS degradation anomaly detected
alerts.detail: Cell-group voltage divergence on rack 4 exceeds the 28 mV plausibility band.
alerts.recommendation: Schedule OEM inspection; hold rack 4 out of the dispatch stack.

alerts.title: Solar surplus available for 42 minutes
alerts.detail: Forecast PV output exceeds site load by 1.4 MW from 12:20.
alerts.recommendation: Charge BESS at 1.4 MW to capture surplus before curtailment.

alerts.title: Chiller sequencing could reduce energy cost by 4.8%
alerts.detail: Chiller 2 is running at 41% part load where CoP falls below 3.4.
alerts.recommendation: Re-sequence to single-chiller operation until 16:00.

alerts.title: Power factor drift below 0.95
alerts.detail: APFC bank stage 3 is not switching in under inductive load.
alerts.recommendation: Inspect contactor stage 3; PF penalty exposure begins at 0.95.

alerts.title: Off-peak charging window opens in 22 minutes
alerts.detail: Tariff drops to ₹5.40/kWh at 22:00 with 61% SoC headroom.
alerts.recommendation: Charge BESS to 85% before the 06:00 peak block.

alerts.title: Compressed air leak signature detected
alerts.detail: Off-shift baseline flow is 18% above the commissioning benchmark.
alerts.recommendation: Dispatch leak survey; estimated continuous loss 34 kW.

alerts.title: Production shift opportunity identified
alerts.detail: Moving the grinding line 90 minutes later avoids the evening peak block.
alerts.recommendation: Requires human approval — production sequencing is Tier 1.

alerts.title: Inverter 3 underperforming vs string model
alerts.detail: Measured yield is 11% below the modelled expectation at matched irradiance.
alerts.recommendation: Check string 3B for soiling or partial shading.

alerts.title: Thermal storage charge window available
alerts.detail: Ambient temperature favours chiller CoP of 5.2 until 08:00.
alerts.recommendation: Charge thermal storage 3.1 MWh ahead of the afternoon cooling peak.

alerts.title: Contracted demand appears over-subscribed
alerts.detail: Rolling 12-month peak is 14% below the sanctioned load.
alerts.recommendation: Model a contract-demand reduction; indicative annual saving ₹19.4L.

alerts.title: Edge gateway heartbeat degraded
alerts.detail: Two heartbeats missed in the last 15 minutes on gateway GW-02.
alerts.recommendation: Agent has reverted the affected assets to Tier 1 automatically.

alerts.title: EV charging deferral available
alerts.detail: Nine sessions have departure slack beyond the evening peak block.
alerts.recommendation: Defer 0.6 MW of charging to 22:15 — Tier 3, no approval needed.

alerts.title: DG start requested outside consent hours
alerts.detail: A manual DG start was attempted at 02:14, outside consented run hours.
alerts.recommendation: Blocked at the edge. Escalated for human review.

alerts.title: Energy intensity drifting on line 2
alerts.detail: kWh per unit is 6.2% above the 90-day trailing baseline.
alerts.recommendation: Investigate compressed-air pressure setpoint creep.

alerts.title: Flexibility event opportunity
alerts.detail: A 2-hour, 3.2 MW curtailment window is available at ₹4.10/kWh.
alerts.recommendation: Commit 2.4 MW from BESS and non-critical HVAC.

alerts.title: Transformer 2 oil temperature elevated
alerts.detail: Winding temperature reached 78 °C at 82% loading.
alerts.recommendation: Rebalance feeders 3 and 4; inspect cooling fans.

alerts.title: Open-access scheduling window approaching
alerts.detail: Day-ahead open-access nomination closes in 3 hours.
alerts.recommendation: Human approval required — regulated transactions are Tier 1.

alerts.title: Night setback not applied on AHU group 2
alerts.detail: Six AHUs held daytime setpoints through the 22:00–06:00 block.
alerts.recommendation: Apply the night setback schedule; 0.4 MW average reduction.

alerts.title: Meter M-114 reporting implausible values
alerts.detail: Reported 0 kW for 45 minutes against non-zero downstream load.
alerts.recommendation: Data held out of the twin; reconciliation flagged.
